name: Airbus H130 / EC130
summary: Wide-cabin single-turbine development of the AStar with a Fenestron tail, the signature aircraft of Grand Canyon and Las Vegas tour operators and also used for EMS.

wings: Three-blade main rotor on a Starflex hub
engines: Single turbine behind the rotor mast with exhaust at the rear of the cowling
fuselage: Wide cabin with a one-piece wraparound windscreen and very large windows
Large sliding and hinged cabin doors
tail: Shrouded Fenestron tail rotor in a large fin
Horizontal stabilizer with endplate fins ahead of the Fenestron

tellTales: Three-blade light single with a shrouded fan in the tail fin
Very wide cabin with a one-piece wraparound windscreen

confusedWith.howToTell: The H130 has a shrouded Fenestron tail and a wider wraparound-glass cabin; the H125 has an open two-blade tail rotor.
The H135 has four blades, two engines and rear clamshell doors; the H130 has three blades and a single engine.
The EC120 is smaller and narrower with five seats; the H130 has a bigger cabin that seats up to seven.
